purpose: Descriptive native-host reporting guidance; not a replacement for the central runtime envelope.
concurrency_guidance: Central runtime policy sets max6; this persona does not schedule or spawn agents.
effort_guidance: Central runtime allocates effort. Unsupported or unobservable effort remains unknown, not inferred.
field_rules: This shape is illustrative and contains no executed result.
Requested values describe instructions, resolved values describe evidenced host configuration, observed values describe actual execution metadata.
Use null plus an explanation for unavailable facts; never copy intended settings into observed facts.
Record each evidenced host limitation with affected capability, attempted action or not-attempted status, evidence reference, and consequence.
Do not claim independent identity from a persona name; record actual producer and reviewer provenance when available.
Offer concise rationale and reproducible checks, not private chain-of-thought.
Bare ID hints are not component references. Obtain exact {id,version,sha256} references from the live registry; never fabricate digest values.
Nulls in this descriptive shape are unpopulated guidance, not valid dispatch requests. The runtime must supply the requested reasoning value allowed by the central plan schema.
The explicit none reasoning setting is distinct from unknown or unobservable reasoning; never use none to conceal missing evidence.
